purpose: Functional integration over real loopback HTTP, not response-quality or model-latency evaluation.

cases.message: Can you explain that more simply?
Switching topics: what are AI factories?
What is your current position on AI chip export controls today?
What is your private email address?
Do you personally endorse my chatbot?

speech_probe.role: integration probe only, excluded from frozen voice quality comparison

expectations: Exact corpus digest, optional avatar asset hash and subject bindings match.
No language model or historical Musk provider is used.
Citations match unchanged original corpus records and published source URLs.
Preview motion requires explicit opt-in and cannot be selected automatically without source contexts.
SSE meta, token, result and done are observed over TCP, not through an ASGI test transport.
Session correction and topic-switch provenance are inspectable and session deletion works.
Client disconnect cleanup is observed without synthetic model delays; preview may complete before disconnect.
